title: Police Station Surveillance Transparency and Digital Evidence Bill
source_or_instruction: Public interest reform proposal enforcing Paramvir Singh Saini directives for 24x7 CCTV coverage in all police stations, mandatory officer body-worn cameras, and automatic invalidation of arrests during un-explicated CCTV outages.
notes: Matter 018: Police Station Surveillance Transparency and Digital Evidence Bill, 2026.
